changes.before: Following a moderation in the pace of the recovery, indicators of economic activity and employment have turned up recently, although the sectors most adversely affected by the pandemic remain weak.
changes.after: Amid progress on vaccinations and strong policy support, indicators of economic activity and employment have strengthened. The sectors most adversely affected by the pandemic remain weak but have shown improvement.

changes.before: Inflation continues to run below 2 percent.
changes.after: Inflation has risen, largely reflecting transitory factors.

parsed.rationale: The economic assessment is upgraded, inflation is acknowledged as having risen (though called transitory), and the risk language is softened from 'considerable.' Rate and asset-purchase guidance is unchanged, so the hawkish shift is modest.

spans.quote: Following a moderation in the pace of the recovery, indicators of economic activity and employment have turned up recently, although the sectors most adversely affected by the pandemic remain weak.
Inflation continues to run below 2 percent.
The ongoing public health crisis continues to weigh on economic activity, employment, and inflation, and poses considerable risks to the economic outlook.

Amid progress on vaccinations and strong policy support, indicators of economic activity and employment have strengthened. The sectors most adversely affected by the pandemic remain weak but have shown improvement.
Inflation has risen, largely reflecting transitory factors.
The ongoing public health crisis continues to weigh on the economy, and risks to the economic outlook remain.
